code.SGF_TRUNCATED: This game record is incomplete — it may have been cut short when saved.
code.SGF_NOT_SGF: This is not an SGF game record.
code.SGF_INVALID_PROPERTY: The game record contains something unrecognisable.
code.SGF_UNSUPPORTED_BOARD_SIZE: That board size is not supported.
code.SGF_TOO_DEEP: The variations in this record are nested too deeply to open.
code.SGF_UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING: This file cannot be saved in its original encoding. Save it as UTF-8 instead.
code.BOARD_INVALID_COORD: That coordinate is off the board.
code.ENGINE_NOT_FOUND: The KataGo engine could not be found.
code.ENGINE_START_TIMEOUT: The engine took too long to start.
code.ENGINE_CIRCUIT_OPEN: The engine has failed to start repeatedly, so retries are paused.
code.LLM_NO_KEY: No API key has been set.
code.LLM_UNAUTHORIZED: The API key is invalid or has expired.
code.LLM_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
code.LLM_TIMEOUT: The teacher took too long to respond.
code.LLM_NO_TOOL_SUPPORT: This model does not support tool calls.
code.LLM_BAD_RESPONSE: The teacher returned something that could not be read.
code.LLM_UNREACHABLE: The AI service could not be reached.
code.IPC_INVALID_REQUEST: That request was not in the expected form.
code.IPC_INVALID_RESPONSE: The response was not in the expected form.
code.SETTINGS_INVALID: That setting value is not valid.
code.SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE: This system offers no encrypted storage, so the key can only be kept for this session.
code.LIBRARY_FILE_UNREADABLE: This file could not be read.
code.LIBRARY_DUPLICATE: This game is already in your library.
code.LIBRARY_NOT_FOUND: That game could not be found.
code.SOURCE_UNREACHABLE: The external service could not be reached.
code.SOURCE_AUTH_EXPIRED: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
code.SOURCE_SCHEMA_CHANGED: The external service changed its data format, so this feature is unavailable for now.
